test_title: PYST 188: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 23rd Nov, 2021 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

S O _ _ T A S _ _ A T A _ _ N A T _ _ O N A _ _
solution:
Given sequence: S O _ _ T A S _ _ A T A _ _ N A T _ _ O N A _ _

 
• NAONSOTASA → S O **N** **A** T A - S **O N** A T A - **S O** N A T **T - A** O N A **S A**
 
• NAONSOASTA → S O N A T A - S O N A T A - S O N A T **A**** - S** O N A **T** A
 
• NAONSOSATA → S O N A T A - S O N A T A - S O N A T **S** - A O N A T A
 
• NAONSOASON → S O N A T A - S O N A T A - S O N A T **A** - S O N A **O N**

 
• In option 2, SONATA is repeated.

Hence, '**NAONSOASTA**' is the correct answer.
